name: AlertDialog
import: import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogBody, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogTrigger, AlertDialogPortal, AlertDialogOverlay } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/alert-dialog';
whenToUse: Confirming one deliberate, usually destructive or irreversible action before it happens.
Interrupting is justified: losing data, money or access.

whenNotToUse.text: Deletes people should type the name to confirm
Forms or anything to read at length

anatomy.description: the question with the object: “Delete shop.seashell.dev?”.
what will happen and what can’t be undone.
`AlertDialogCancel` and `AlertDialogAction` labelled with the verb (“Delete site”), danger tone for destructive.

do.caption: Open it: the title names the object, the button names the action.
do.example:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button appearance="outlined" tone="danger" size="md">Delete site</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete shop.seashell.dev?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>Its files, databases and 14 backups are removed. This can’t be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction>Delete site</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

dont.caption: “Are you sure? Yes / No” — sure about what, and what does Yes do?
dont.example:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button appearance="outlined" tone="danger" size="md">Delete site</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Are you sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>Please confirm.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>No</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction>Yes</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

a11y: It’s an `alertdialog`: focus starts on Cancel (the safe choice), Escape cancels, focus returns to the trigger.
Title and description are read when it opens — put the consequence there, not in the button.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show the separator line between the body and the footer (dialogs with form/body content).

components.name: AlertDialogAction
components.description: The confirming action. Defaults to a danger-tone Button and closes the dialog.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render onto the child element instead of a <button> (shadcn/Radix Slot convention).

props.name: badge
props.description:
Count or status pinned to the top-right corner (a BadgeIndicator, sm,
circle). Pass a number/short text (`badge={5}`, `badge="9+"`), or an
object for a dot or another tone: `{ dot: true }`, `{ value: 3, tone: 'info' }`.
Default tone is danger. Not rendered with `asChild`.

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
What the badge means, read after the button's name ("5 unread",
"new"). The badge itself is aria-hidden — without this, screen
reader users get no count at all. Dev warning when missing.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Renders as a square icon-only button (no label). Provide the icon via leftIcon.

props.name: leftIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label (or the sole icon when iconOnly is set).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of leftIcon and disables the button. Not supported with asChild.

props.name: softDisabled
props.description:
Soft-disable: looks disabled and ignores clicks/Enter/Space, but stays
in the tab order and keeps receiving hover/focus (uses aria-disabled
instead of the native `disabled` attribute). Use it when the user needs
to find the button and learn WHY it's unavailable — wrap it in a
Tooltip with the reason. `disabled` stays the hard version (removed
from the tab order, no events at all).

props.name: success
props.description:
The action just succeeded: a tick draws itself in place of leftIcon (Kinetics'
Status Pill, MIT). Pair it with a label that says so ("Deployed") and, usually,
`tone="success"`; turn it off again after a moment. Not supported with asChild.

components.name: AlertDialogCancel
components.description: The dismissing action. Renders an outlined Button and closes the dialog.
